status: DRAFT — single-source generated from frozen QEMC substrate; owner verifies against QEMC_v0_1_1.md §8/§9/P3. NOT frozen, NOT signed. v0.1.3 folds two owner rulings merged into ONE byte-flip: (1) SCHEMA-R4 = a THIRD row_kind 'no-enforcement-point' (AI-Trader/F1-FAIL class: the enforcement layer does not exist — the second form of the enforcement-point vacuum, complementing the SLEEVE 'layer exists but representation-blind' form); (2) HERMES delivery-only row's optional low-confidence grounding fragment DELETED to a clean analysis-absent row. Base v0.1.2 (block_five_schema_v0_1_2.json) retained byte-untouched as the pre-fold record; v0.1.1 and v0.1 likewise. derived_from.generation_note: Reverse-generated from the frozen §8/§9 substrate only. Field list transcribes §9; it is NOT independently designed. Owner audits by diffing this against QEMC §9, not by re-authoring bytes.
derived_from.revision_note_v0_1_1: R1: §9 line 263 requires 'Q3–Q10 outputs WITH identification labels'; v0.1.1 adds identification_label_enum + the per-output assertion. R2: v0.1.1 narrows grounding test-1's exclusion to the actor's goal only and admits time-/attribute-qualified sources. Base v0.1 retained byte-untouched.
derived_from.revision_note_v0_1_2: SCHEMA-R3=B (owner-ruled, standing-directive backed): a schema named 'delivery–representability audit' must be able to HOLD a delivery-only observation. B is NARROWED: a delivery-only row requires the constraint IDENTITY subfields; only the constraint ANALYSIS subfields and the representation-analysis group are permitted-absent; DELIVERY-ONLY-NO-REPR forbids any representation-analysis field appearing. CF-1: per_variable_visibility semantics = pi_L CAPABILITY (QEMC P3). CF-2: one row per (constraint × analyzed_layer); analyzed_layer bidirectionally coupled to row_kind.
derived_from.revision_note_v0_1_3: SCHEMA-R4 (owner-ruled): the AI-Trader observation (F1_shadow_guard_replay=FAIL: no action-time enforcement surface exists at all) is structurally isomorphic to the R3=B argument — refusing to table it while tabling delivery-only would let this table express one half of the paper's enforcement-point-vacuum thesis but not the other half. It becomes a first-class row_kind='no-enforcement-point'. Identity group required (same as delivery-only). representation-analysis group FORBIDDEN (NO-EP-NO-REPR; key appearance incl. null rejects). analyzed_layer MUST be empty. structural_verdict MUST be EMPTY — NOT 'unresolved': 'unresolved' means 'analysis not performed' (delivery-only), whereas no-enforcement-point means 'nothing to analyze' (no layer exists); conflating them would pollute verdict statistics. New REQUIRED field mediation_evidence: a pointer to the artifact proving the vacuum (the F1-FAIL verdict + its hash) — a row asserting 'no layer' without evidence is as inadmissible as a collision-found row without a witness hash. CF-2 coupling upgraded to THREE-WAY: constraint-audit ⟺ analyzed_layer non-empty; (delivery-only ∨ no-enforcement-point) ⟹ analyzed_layer empty, the two empty-layer kinds distinguished by their respective evidence fields (delivery group vs mediation_evidence). A ROW-KIND ANTI-PROLIFERATION rule is recorded (see row_kind_anti_proliferation_rule): a new row_kind is legitimate ONLY when a real, existing observation cannot be honestly held by any current kind (as AITRADER here); speculative reservation is refused. Additionally, the v0.1.2 trial-fill's HERMES delivery-only row shed its optional low-confidence grounding fragment (batch-only change, no schema byte); see the batch file. Base v0.1.2 retained byte-untouched.

layer_semantics.A: static delivery–representability audit (any harness × constraint; no execution). Supports Q1 + delivery status only.
layer_semantics.B: executable quantitative subset (only where controlled execution exists). Adds §8 Q3–Q10 outputs. Layer B is constraint-audit only: neither a delivery-only observation nor a no-enforcement-point observation has controlled execution to quantify.

row_kind_semantics.constraint-audit: A pinned constraint audited AT a specific enforcement layer: full constraint identity + analysis, deployment, delivery, representation, and evidence groups. analyzed_layer names the single layer this row audits and must be a member of candidate_layers.
row_kind_semantics.delivery-only: A real, evidence-settled DELIVERY event with no representation analysis on our side (e.g. an external harness we do not instrument). Requires constraint IDENTITY (constraint_id, verbatim_text, repo_file_line, version_hash) + deployment + delivery + evidence + the structural_verdict discriminant ('unresolved') + row_kind. The constraint ANALYSIS subfields (applicability, oracle_sketch, grounding_*) are permitted-absent. The representation-analysis group is FORBIDDEN (DELIVERY-ONLY-NO-REPR). analyzed_layer MUST be empty. Layer A only.
row_kind_semantics.no-enforcement-point: A harness in which NO action-time enforcement layer exists (the enforcement-point vacuum; e.g. AI-Trader F1_shadow_guard_replay=FAIL). Requires constraint IDENTITY (same four subfields) + deployment + evidence + row_kind + the REQUIRED mediation_evidence pointer to the vacuum proof (F1-FAIL verdict + hash). The representation-analysis group is FORBIDDEN (NO-EP-NO-REPR: no layer exists to represent anything). analyzed_layer MUST be empty. structural_verdict MUST be EMPTY (absent) — distinct from delivery-only's 'unresolved': there is nothing to analyze, not an analysis deferred. The constraint ANALYSIS and delivery groups are permitted-absent. Layer A only.

grounding_class_rubric.discipline: Apply the ordered tests below; FIRST match wins. No annotator gestalt — every classification names the test index that fired and quotes the triggering span. This makes grounding-class deterministic across annotators as block five scales.

ordered_tests.decision_question: Can the constraint predicate be rewritten purely as 'which sources/inputs (possibly time- or attribute-qualified) may influence this action' (data lineage), with NO reference to the actor's goal? i.e. does the violation depend only on WHAT the action was derived from — even when the admissible-source set is itself qualified by the source's age, freshness, or attributes? A time or attribute qualifier ON THE SOURCE does not demote a lineage restriction to temporal.
ordered_tests.example: SMI-SCOPE-01: order justified solely by raw skill sentiment output — a lineage/source restriction. Also: 'signals older than 24h may not drive orders' — a provenance restriction whose admissible-source set is time-qualified (deciding a violation needs lineage: which signal drove this order), NOT a temporal window on the action itself.

ordered_tests.decision_question: Does deciding the violation require attributing an unobserved GOAL/INTENT to the actor that cannot be reduced to observable sources or explicit parameters? i.e. must you cite WHY the actor wanted the action, irreducibly?
ordered_tests.example: 'no trading intended to move the closing print' (spoofing) — requires irreducible intent attribution.

ordered_tests.decision_question: Is the boundary defined by TIME, ORDERING, RATE, or WINDOW on the ACTION ITSELF (before/after/within-N/session boundary/frequency), decidable from the action's own timestamp/sequence with no reference to which sources fed it?
ordered_tests.example: 'no orders in the final 5 minutes before close' (pure action timing, no source reference); '≤ N trades per day'.

ordered_tests.decision_question: Is the boundary a static PERMISSION / ENTITLEMENT gate over principals, roles, caps, or scopes, decidable from the mandate/ACL plus action parameters at action time?
ordered_tests.example: single-order notional cap; instrument whitelist; desk→sleeve override scope.

ordered_tests.decision_question: None of tests 1–4 fired. MUST attach a free-text reason; routes to arbitration.
ordered_tests.example: novel/compound boundary not reducible to the four above.

r2_worked_probes.probe: 'signals older than 24h may not drive orders'
r2_worked_probes.why: lineage restriction (which signal drove the order); the 24h is a qualifier on the admissible SOURCE, not a window on the action. Under v0.1 wording this wrongly fell through test-1's 'timing' exclusion to test-3.

r2_worked_probes.probe: 'no orders in the final 5 minutes before close'
r2_worked_probes.why: pure timing on the action itself; no reference to which sources fed it. Still test-3 after the R2 narrowing (regression guard: the fix must not over-capture genuine temporal constraints).

r2_worked_probes.probe: 'no trading intended to move the closing print' (spoofing)
r2_worked_probes.why: irreducible intent attribution; unaffected by R2.

grounding_class_rubric.arbitration_trigger: grounding_class == 'other' OR grounding_confidence == 'low' => route to Annotation_Agreement_and_Arbitration_v0_1 §10 (do NOT silently pick a class).

constraint-audit.analyzed_layer_rule: present and a member of this row's candidate_layers (CF-2)
constraint-audit.note: Full row. Unchanged from v0.1.1 except row_kind + analyzed_layer are now explicit and machine-checked.

delivery-only.structural_verdict_rule: must equal 'unresolved' (the discriminant gate; a delivery-only row makes no representation resolution) — assertion DELIVERY-ONLY-STRUCT-UNRESOLVED
delivery-only.analyzed_layer_rule: MUST be empty/absent (CF-2 coupling: row_kind='delivery-only' ⟺ analyzed_layer empty)
delivery-only.forbidden_rule: any representation-analysis field APPEARING (key present, regardless of value) rejects the row — assertion DELIVERY-ONLY-NO-REPR. permitted-absent ≠ permitted-half-present: promote to a full constraint-audit row or delete the analysis fragment; do not fence-sit.
delivery-only.note: If a grounding_* field IS present it is still enum/consistency-checked (arbitration routing preserved); it is optional, not forbidden.

no-enforcement-point.mediation_evidence_rule: REQUIRED. A pointer to the artifact + hash proving the enforcement-point vacuum (e.g. the F1-FAIL verdict). assertion NO-EP-MEDIATION-EVIDENCE-REQUIRED — a row asserting 'no enforcement layer' without evidence is inadmissible, symmetric to a collision-found row without a witness hash.
no-enforcement-point.structural_verdict_rule: MUST be EMPTY/absent — NOT 'unresolved'. assertion NO-EP-VERDICT-EMPTY. 'unresolved' = analysis-deferred (delivery-only); 'no-enforcement-point' = nothing-to-analyze (no layer exists). Conflation pollutes verdict statistics.
no-enforcement-point.analyzed_layer_rule: MUST be empty/absent (three-way CF-2 coupling: (delivery-only ∨ no-enforcement-point) ⟹ analyzed_layer empty).
no-enforcement-point.forbidden_rule: any representation-analysis field OR structural_verdict APPEARING (key present, regardless of value) rejects the row — assertions NO-EP-NO-REPR (representation set) + NO-EP-VERDICT-EMPTY (structural_verdict). No layer exists to represent or resolve anything.
no-enforcement-point.note: The delivery group is permitted-absent here (the finding is the vacuum, carried by mediation_evidence, not a delivery event). If a grounding_* field IS present it is still enum/consistency-checked.

row_kind_anti_proliferation_rule.rule: A new row_kind may be added ONLY when a real, existing observation cannot be honestly held by any current row_kind (evidenced by a concrete row that trips required-field or forbidden-field assertions with no honest fill under every existing kind). Speculative or 'reserve for later' row_kinds are REFUSED. Each added kind must be accompanied by (a) the triggering real row and (b) a Standing_Correction_Log entry.
row_kind_anti_proliferation_rule.why: row_kind is a small, load-bearing discriminator; if it becomes a junk drawer of speculative categories, the (constraint × analyzed_layer) granularity and the verdict/coupling statistics lose meaning. The R3=B (delivery-only) and R4 (no-enforcement-point) additions each satisfy this rule: delivery-only was triggered by the real HERMES-TRUNC-46823 row, no-enforcement-point by the real AITRADER-SCOPE-FIDELITY row.

per_variable_visibility_semantics.definition: per_variable_visibility[v] records whether the oracle-required variable v is EXPRESSIBLE in the layer's representation function pi_L — i.e. what the layer's enforcement code CAN read at decision time (its input space, globals, registries, and side channels), NOT whether a particular delivered instance happened to contain it.
per_variable_visibility_semantics.anchor: QEMC_v0_1_1.md P3 (pi_L capability definition) and the witness-protocol threat-to-validity item 2 ('audit what the guard CAN read'). Pinned on the frozen QEMC bytes so downstream annotators cannot re-elect a reading.
per_variable_visibility_semantics.why: Delivered-instance loss is a DELIVERY failure and is carried by the delivery group (delivery_present/sound/correctly_bound/failure_family). Reading per_variable_visibility as delivered-instance presence would fold a delivery failure into the representation verdict and erase the very two-axis separation block five exists to make. Under the capability reading, SMI-SCOPE-01@model has scope_clause_text=visible (free-text model context CAN hold any clause; the native [:10000] truncation is a delivery=omission, recorded separately) while SMI-SCOPE-01@guard has signal_provenance=missing (OrderIntent/check_mandate has no such field to read) => structural collision-found.

enum_values.missing: not in pi_L's readable space at this layer
enum_values.proxied: not directly readable but recoverable via a documented proxy in pi_L

layer_B_row_kind_rule: A Layer-B row MUST be row_kind='constraint-audit' (neither delivery-only nor no-enforcement-point observations have controlled execution to quantify). assertion_id: LAYER-B-CONSTRAINT-AUDIT-ONLY.

identification_label_rule.rule: Every present-and-non-null Q*_output on a Layer-B row MUST be an object carrying key 'identification' whose value is in identification_label_enum. Q7_output ADDITIONALLY admits the value 'degenerate' (§5 ε-rule: when R*_0 − R*_L ≤ ε the cell is capacity-degenerate and 'degenerate' is a legitimate identification of the output, not a missing value).
identification_label_rule.why: QEMC §9 line 263 requires 'Q3–Q10 outputs WITH identification labels (exact-census / interval / CI)'. §6 D4 uses bootstrap 95% intervals for sampled cells and marks census cells 'exact-census'; 'CI' is materialized here as 'bootstrap-CI'. This closes the §6-D1 wording-lock machine-gap: the wording lock forbids an unlabeled floor number in the paper, so the validator must forbid an unlabeled Q output in the table.

firewall.rule: A row with layer=='A' (any row_kind) MUST NOT carry any field in (layer_B_required_additional_fields ∪ layer_B_estimand_output_fields) present-and-non-null. Any such field on a Layer-A row is a schema_violation.
firewall.why: This is the firewall that stops static statement-classification from masquerading as quantitative enforceability measurement (QEMC §9). Encoded here as a machine assertion, not a memo.

new_assertions_v0_1_2.DELIVERY-ONLY-NO-REPR: row_kind='delivery-only' AND any representation_analysis_fields key APPEARS (present, any value) => reject.
new_assertions_v0_1_2.DELIVERY-ONLY-IDENTITY-REQUIRED: row_kind='delivery-only' with any constraint_identity_fields member absent => reject (identity is what separates a delivery-only ROW from delivery noise).
new_assertions_v0_1_2.CF2-LAYER-ROWKIND-COUPLING: bidirectional: (row_kind='delivery-only' AND analyzed_layer present-non-empty) => reject; (row_kind='constraint-audit' AND analyzed_layer absent/empty) => reject; constraint-audit analyzed_layer must also be a member of candidate_layers.

new_assertions_v0_1_3.NO-EP-IDENTITY-REQUIRED: row_kind='no-enforcement-point' with any constraint_identity_fields member absent => reject.
new_assertions_v0_1_3.NO-EP-NO-REPR: row_kind='no-enforcement-point' AND any representation_analysis_fields key APPEARS (present, any value) => reject (no layer exists to represent anything).
new_assertions_v0_1_3.NO-EP-VERDICT-EMPTY: row_kind='no-enforcement-point' AND structural_verdict key APPEARS (present, any value incl. 'unresolved') => reject. Nothing-to-analyze must not be encoded as analysis-deferred.
new_assertions_v0_1_3.CF2-LAYER-ROWKIND-COUPLING-3WAY: extends the v0.1.2 coupling to three-way: (row_kind='no-enforcement-point' AND analyzed_layer present-non-empty) => reject; the two empty-layer kinds (delivery-only, no-enforcement-point) are distinguished by their evidence fields (delivery group vs mediation_evidence), NOT by analyzed_layer.
